scope: Linux local follow-up; Windows verification pending

checks: atomic rename preserves both old opens, isolates writes and charges retained data until last CLOSE
periodic lease expiry releases unlinked bytes without any NFS client traffic
unlink retains descriptor and quota across NFS worker crash; matching OPEN reclaim and last CLOSE release it
private links preserve data, identity and quota through file-domain kill and all-service restart; reclaim/CLOSE removes durable storage
journal before private link creation preserves original file and handle
private link before unlink is rolled back without deleting original data
interrupted final reaping completes idempotently and leaves old handle STALE
EXPORT and DUMP filter root-squashed/unmapped principals; duplicate MNT is idempotent
mount records survive reconnect; UMNT/UMNTALL affect only caller and preserve NFS filehandles
rpcbind v2/v3/v4 DUMP and v4 GETVERSADDR advertise only implemented TCP services
recognized unsupported file types return per-operation errors after successful SEQUENCE/PUTFH
BACKCHANNEL_CTL updates bounded callback configuration; unknown GSS, SP4_NONE SET_SSV and obsolete v4.0 operations return defined per-operation errors
export revocation immediately hides discovery and denies subsequent MNT
TCP record fragmentation and MOUNT v3 with independent XDR codecs
unknown UID/GID/groups rejected; root squashed to explicitly unprivileged subject
root squash uses anonymous read rights, strips privileged groups and rejects writes/revoked rights
read-only TCP portmapper advertises NFS and does not advertise unsupported NLM
trailing XDR rejected before WRITE; previously persisted bytes remain intact
v3 guarded CREATE, 64 KiB UNSTABLE upgraded to FILE_SYNC, READ, COMMIT, exact duplicate WRITE
MAC tamper rejected; file handle survives external rename and all-service restart; durable v3 replay and new write verifier
deleted/recreated path cannot revive an old file handle
v3 MKDIR, cross-directory RENAME, READDIRPLUS, REMOVE/RMDIR type separation
pynfs v4.1 EXCHANGE_ID/CREATE_SESSION/SEQUENCE, guarded OPEN, WRITE/READ, exact slot replay
false slot replay and foreign stateid rejected; GETATTR subset independently decoded
old sessions/stateids invalidated on reboot; persisted owner can reclaim OPEN during grace; CLOSE releases recovery record
unrelated client cannot reclaim another owner after restart
export disable revokes existing handles through fresh identity grants
offline metadata backup strips NFS enrollment and excludes persistent capability/recovery databases

pynfs.name: all
pynfs.note: Unmodified upstream suite; run before the subsequent BACKCHANNEL_CTL/obsolete-operation correction. The excluded delegation and special-file/link profiles are not passes. Other unselected tests remain in the upstream skipped total.
